1.web: Then Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God, out of the fish’s belly.
1.asv: Then Jonah prayed unto Jehovah his God out of the fish’s belly.

2.web: He said, “I called because of my affliction to Yahweh. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.
2.asv: And he said, I called by reason of mine affliction unto Jehovah, And he answered me; Out of the belly of Sheol cried I, And thou heardest my voice.

3.web: For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.
3.asv: For thou didst cast me into the depth, in the heart of the seas, And the flood was round about me; All thy waves and thy billows passed over me.

4.web: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
4.asv: And I said, I am cast out from before thine eyes; Yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.

5.web: The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.
5.asv: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul; The deep was round about me; The weeds were wrapped about my head.

6.web: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever: yet have you brought up my life from the pit, Yahweh my God.
6.asv: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; The earth with its bars closed upon me for ever: Yet hast thou brought up my life from the pit, O Jehovah my God.

7.web: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahweh. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.
7.asv: When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Jehovah; And my prayer came in unto thee, into thy holy temple.

8.web: Those who regard lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
8.asv: They that regard lying vanities Forsake their own mercy.

9.web: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to Yahweh.”
9.asv: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation is of Jehovah.

10.web: Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.
10.asv: And Jehovah spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
